answer: Import FormlyMatDatepickerModule from @ngx-formly/material/datepicker; it registers datepicker with the form-field wrapper and is not included in FormlyMaterialModule. Configure date limits under props.datepickerOptions.min/max, using adapter-compatible values. Date adapter selection remains separate: the Formly module does not choose it. This is not a complete application setup or universal parsing guarantee.
reason: Supply module/import/type, nested date limits and separate adapter responsibility together.

answer: Set resetOnHide: false on the field to skip the hide handler’s value-clearing branch. The hidden control can still be unregistered from the active control tree; preserving the model value does not guarantee preserving active control registration.
reason: Give resetOnHide:false preserving model during hiding, with no claim it keeps a hidden control registered.
